text_block_list.text:
When we arrived in Kyoto to participate in 
the Shuka Sho, the final crown of the 
Tiara route—
(Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Wawa, there's so many people...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what's going on? Is some 
celebrity visiting Japan or something?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Where? Where is it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Vivlos~~~~! Give it your allllll!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
I will watch over your challenge carefully 
until the very end...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's true~~!? I'm, like, totally a 
celebrity!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, yeah! I've gained so many 
followers... Doesn't that make me, like, a 
suuuper celeb?!"

Her debut race had also been right here at 
Kyoto, and back then, fans of her family 
had welcomed her. But now—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos, you're so cute~~! I'm rooting for 
you! Win the Shuka Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyooone!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mmm, mwah♡

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO!!
Kyaaa~~!! Look this way, Verxina-chan!

What incredible hospitality! As expected 
of our daughter!!
choice_data_list: There are passionate fans over there too—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh!? Everyone's here!?

Appearing among the crowd of fans were 
Vivlos's family... Verxina, Cheval Grand, 
and their parents too.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
—Ehehe, I'm here♡ After all, it's 
Vivlos-chan's big moment.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
...That's what Trainer said when they 
invited me, but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainie is?!
choice_data_list: I thought it might be of help to you.
I thought it could help you.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Of course I planned on going and cleared 
my schedule, but... the final adjustments 
just didn't go well at all.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Still, Trainer sent me such a passionate 
message, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
"‘If there's anything I can do, I'll do 
whatever it takes. So please, you must 
come to the Shuka Sho.’ ...is what she 
said."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
"It felt like a swift kick in the rear! 
Thanks to that, I managed to get 
everything under control!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Trainy, thank you so much♡

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
"Give it all you've got, Vivlos! You can 
do it!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Dad, that suit! I definitely 
recognize it!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that's the one they wore during 
Verxina's race too!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I told them not to because it's bad 
luck, but...

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! This suit carries so many 
cherished memories and feelings.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
It's sure to give Vilbros strength. Right, 
Cheval!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Why me...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Cheva-chi, thanks for coming even though 
you're busy!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It's not like... I'm not rooting for you 
or anything.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Today may be the last, but please don't 
overdo it. Your true dream lies in Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Still... I'm cheering for you with all my 
heart. I'm praying for your victory.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —Right.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Vivlos~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that's weird... Ahaha. Why am I 
trembling?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Is that really true?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Today won't ever happen again. If I lose 
now, then...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Did I really do my best? Will I be all 
right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But... it makes me scared.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
What if my stomach starts hurting on the 
way? What if I feel awful...?
choice_data_list: I've made as many adjustments as I could.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...You never really know how the real race 
is gonna go, you know?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I wonder... if I can make everyone smile?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainy...
choice_data_list:
Your devotion to your family will lead you 
to victory.

Your devotion to your family will lead you 
to victory.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: My... feelings.
choice_data_list:
Let's give the greatest victory to my 
beloved family.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
For my sake... I will do what's best for 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: âI'm off!
